gloss: character profile; portrait of a person; persona

definitions.gloss: character profile; portrait of a person; persona
definitions.explanation: A description or image of what a person is like — their personality, background, and characteristics. Used for real people and fictional characters alike.

examples.japanese: ⟦{主人公|しゅじんこう}→主人公：11404_shujinkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{人物像|じんぶつぞう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: To portray the main character's persona.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{人物像|じんぶつぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がって→浮かび上がる：06858_ukabiagaru⟧きた。
examples.english: A profile of the suspect has started to emerge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧{人物像|じんぶつぞう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}っている→合う：10466_au⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: In interviews, they check whether the candidate matches the desired candidate profile.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧ (person; character) + ⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧ (image; portrait). Used broadly: in literature for character descriptions, in crime reporting for suspect profiles, and in business for ideal candidate descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人物像|じんぶつぞう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧: to portray a character
- {人物像|じんぶつぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる→浮かび上がる：06858_ukabiagaru⟧: a profile emerges
- ⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧{人物像|じんぶつぞう}: desired candidate profile
- ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{人物像|じんぶつぞう}: suspect profile

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{人柄|ひとがら}→人柄：08163_hitogara⟧: personality; character — more about personal warmth and temperament
- ⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧: person; figure — the person themselves, not the description of them
- ⟦プロフィール→プロフィール：06474_purofiiru⟧: profile — typically a factual summary (name, age, background)
